title: Cooling tower cells — sequence of operations
note: PRD-SETPOINT-SIM P3. Curated; thresholds resolved by tools/build-sequences.mjs (see chiller.json).

basis.ref: ASHRAE Guideline 36-2021, chilled-water plant sequences (developed under ASHRAE RP-1711)
basis.use: the structure: tower fans hold the condenser water supply setpoint, cells follow the chillers, minimum entering condenser water protection
basis.limits: the numbers come from this plant's engine, limits registry and control registry, not from the guideline

plant: one induced-draft cell per chiller, no standby cells (js/conv-engine.js tower_standby_cells 0); a cell's rating is its heat rejection at full fan speed at the design wet bulb and approach

modes.label: Normal — fans hold CDW supply

entry.text: condenser water loop enabled and the cells of the running chillers proven

actions: run one cell per running chiller
the fan speed (VSD) holds the condenser water supply at its setpoint

exit.text: entering condenser water below the chillers' minimum

assumed.delay_s 300: 5 min confirmation of a high condenser water temperature; no source in this repo states it

modes.label: Follow the chillers
actions: open (or close) the isolation valves of its cell

exit.event: the cell count equals the running chillers

modes.label: Cell fan trip — start an idle cell

entry.event: a running cell's fan trips (VSD fault, vibration or motor protection)

actions: lock out the tripped cell, close its isolation valves, raise an alarm
the remaining fans run to full speed; CDW supply rises while rejection is short
open the valves of an idle cell and start its fan

exit.event: the idle cell is proven running

modes.notModelled: whether the cells share one condenser water header is not stated by the engine; starting an idle cell for another chiller assumes they do

modes.label: High condenser water — all cells
actions: run every available cell, fans at full speed

modes.label: Low entering condenser water — bypass

entry.text: entering condenser water below the chillers' minimum

actions: fans to minimum speed, then off
the tower 3-way bypass holds the minimum entering condenser water

exit.text: entering condenser water at or above the minimum
